# MM-P1-L1-IH03 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge induction billet heater #3

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Scope
This document provides maintenance guidance for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03). It covers preventive and corrective tasks required to maintain safe and reliable heating of billets prior to forging operations. Tasks include inspection of electrical and cooling systems, coil integrity checks, thermal verification, and housekeeping that could affect heater performance. Refer to related documents MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3, SB-1009, and SOP-P1-L1-01 for supplementary procedures, safety bulletins, and operating instructions.

Background and rationale
EQ-P1-L1-IH03 is a high-power induction heater that must deliver consistent billet surface temperature to ensure metallurgical and dimensional outcomes in the subsequent forge operation. The specified target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C. Maintaining coil condition and cooling system performance is critical to prevent overheating of the coil assembly and power electronics, and to ensure uniform heat transfer to billets. Coil cooling water flow must be verified because reduced flow increases local coil temperature and risk of damage; the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 72 L/min. The steps below prioritize verification of those parameters and provide acceptance criteria tied to those values.

Tools
- Electrical insulated hand tools and torque tools as defined in SOP-P1-L1-01.  
- Infrared surface pyrometer and contact thermocouple as directed in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 for temperature verification.  
- Portable flow meter compatible with induction coil cooling circuit for measurement against the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03).  
- Coil inspection mirror and borescope for internal visual checks.  
- Thermal imaging camera for trend analysis and hotspot identification, used in accordance with SB-1009.  
- Personal protective equipment as required by SOP-P1-L1-01 and SB-1009.

Procedure
Preparation
- Verify isolation and lockout of EQ-P1-L1-IH03 per SOP-P1-L1-01 prior to any invasive inspection. Confirm that power and cooling supplies are secured and that area access is restricted.
- Review previous records for EQ-P1-L1-IH03 for recurring issues referenced in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 and SB-1009 to focus inspection on known weak points.

Visual and mechanical inspection
- Inspect coil external surfaces for scoring, deformation, or discoloration. Use the borescope to inspect internal coil channels and insulation joints. Look for signs of arcing, carbon tracking, or erosion of insulation materials.
- Inspect cooling hose and fittings for chafing, hardening, or contamination. Clean and secure fittings as needed. Rationale: mechanical wear can cause leaks that reduce flow and allow air ingress that degrades cooling effectiveness.

Cooling system verification
- Re-establish cooling supply and check for flow continuity using the portable flow meter placed on the coil circuit. Verify that the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is achieved. Rationale: flow at or above the specified minimum is required to remove heat from the coil and prevent thermal runaway.
- Record flow meter readings and note any transient variability. If flow is below the required minimum, execute corrective actions per SB-1009 and stop heating operations until resolved.

Electrical and control checks
- With power re-applied under controlled conditions per SOP-P1-L1-01, perform insulation resistance checks to the grounded structure using approved test equipment. Observe manufacturer guidance for acceptable procedures as referenced in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3.
- Verify control interlocks and safety trips related to coil temperature and cooling flow are operational. Rationale: interlocks are the last line of defense against equipment damage.

Thermal verification
- Run a controlled heat cycle using a representative billet following SOP-P1-L1-01. Use the infrared pyrometer and contact thermocouple to measure billet temperature at the workpiece surface. Confirm that the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is reached within acceptable process behavior as described in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3.
- Use the thermal imaging camera to inspect the coil and surrounding structure during heating for any abnormal hotspots identified by SB-1009. Rationale: hotspots indicate cooling deficiency or electrical fault.

Corrective actions
- If coil damage or insulation degradation is found, remove the coil from service and follow repair or replacement actions authorized in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3. Document condition and vendor communications.
- If flow is below the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03), trace the circuit for partial blockages, valve settings, or pump performance issues. Implement corrective measures and re-verify flow.

Examples and troubleshooting notes
- Example: If thermal imaging shows a localized hotspot near a coil end connection while measured flow meets the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03), inspect the connection for poor contact or degraded insulation. Tighten or replace connectors per manufacturer guidance in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 and re-check thermal signature.
- Example: If billet temperatures fluctuate below the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) despite normal coil condition and cooling flow, verify coil coupling and alignment, and consult the control system diagnostics referenced in SOP-P1-L1-01.

Records to keep
- Maintenance log entry for EQ-P1-L1-IH03 including inspection findings, flow meter readings, thermal measurements, and actions taken. Cross-reference log to MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 records when repairs are performed.
- Thermal images and pyrometer/thermocouple readings stored in the equipment folder along with flow meter reports. Include any deviation reports generated under SB-1009 and corrective action closure per SOP-P1-L1-01.
- Supplier communication and replacement part documentation when coil repair or replacement is performed.

Acceptance criteria
- No visible coil damage or compromised insulation remaining in service.  
- Coil cooling water flow meets or exceeds the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 72 L/min as measured during verification.  
- Billet heating performance achieves the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C under normal process conditions as verified by pyrometer or thermocouple.  
- All safety interlocks and alarms pass functional checks and documentation is filed in accordance with SOP-P1-L1-01 and referencing MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 and SB-1009 where applicable.

End of document.
